what_this_is: The CURRENT deployment pins, in two blocks that are two different facts. `live` is what production serves: the deployment record's own numbers, moved ONLY by a deployment-authorization order. `source` is what a FRESH assembly of the committed source produces: moved by an application order, which puts source AHEAD of production until the next deploy. When the two agree, ahead_of_production is false and moved_by is null. Consumed historical authorizations are never restated here; they live in deploy/netlify/deployment_authorizations and are immutable evidence of what was authorized at the time (see supersessions.json).

live.note: Detroit / Ann Arbor is live as the TWELFTH market at 121 published profiles over a 247-identity census. Production moved 803 -> 924 profiles and 966 -> 1099 routes; every previously live market kept its exact profile count and no route was removed, proved against the previous deploy's own sitemap read from its own address. All 5646 live routes returned 200 and were byte-identical to the authorized bundle. PTF-DETROIT-ANN-ARBOR-LAUNCH-PREP-031 prepared this launch and wrote the participation row as an unsigned proposal; this order signed it. Signing moved the participation record's own sha256 from 057ead0385db06bb to 9c39ba4a089440e1 and moved NO byte of the bundle -- the reassembly from the signed commit reproduced 92b39c81c31988a1 exactly, which is why this is the first launch whose prepared packet digest IS the deployed one. No market is registered and withheld any more: every registered market is live. Fort Wayne and Lexington are not registered.

source.note: In sync with production: what production serves IS a fresh assembly of the committed source at bbc8395. No application order has moved a market since.
